title: Atlassian Bitbucket and login outage, Nov 23, 2026

subject.name: Atlassian Bitbucket
subject.about: Bitbucket is Atlassian's service for software teams, combining source code storage, issue tracking and automated build and deployment pipelines.

disclaimer: Made for entertainment using AI. Not endorsed by Atlassian, any government agency, news outlet, company, or anyone else named.
size_basis: Potential reach is broad: the failing sign-in service is shared by Bitbucket, Jira, JSM, Trello and Confluence, which are widely used by software and business teams. Atlassian lists only partial outages, applied a fix about 75 minutes in, and has not said how many customers were hit.
who_is_affected: People and teams who sign in to Bitbucket, Jira, JSM, Trello or Confluence through Atlassian's OAuth service, or run Bitbucket Pipelines, from 10:19 AM ET on Monday, Nov 23. Atlassian reported signs of recovery from 11:33 AM ET and marked the incident resolved at 3:44 PM ET the same day.

known.text: Atlassian's Bitbucket status page opened an incident at 10:19 AM ET on Nov 23 for failing OAuth token requests.
On Bitbucket, Authentication and user management and Pipelines were listed as partial outages; the website, API and Git access showed operational.
The same sign-in incident is posted on Atlassian's Jira, Jira Service Management, Trello, Developer and Confluence status pages.
Atlassian says it identified the cause at 11:08 AM ET and applied a mitigation at 11:33 AM ET, with signs of recovery. It has not said what the cause is.
Atlassian marked the incident resolved at 3:44 PM ET on Nov 23, about five and a half hours after it began, and says the service is operating normally.

not_known.text: What caused the outage. Atlassian has not said.
Whether it was an attack. No one has claimed one and Atlassian has not addressed it.
Whether Atlassian will publish a post-incident report. None was posted at our last check.
